705266.t: ἐφίσταμαι [ἐπι-στα-] (ephístamai [epi-sta-], “stand on, over, or near”) + -της (-tēs, masculine agent noun suffix): literally, one who stands on, over, or near something or someone.

705264.t: From earlier *ἐπι-hίσταμαι (*epi-hístamai), with early loss of the breath *-h- and vowel contraction, with sense development "stand before something" > "be confronted with something" > "take knowledge of something" similar to that of Proto-West Germanic…

705250.t: ἐπι- (epi-, “epi-, on-”) + σκέπτομαι (sképtomai, “to look at, examine”).

705205.t: From ἐπι- (epi-) + μιμνήσκω (mimnḗskō), in the mediopassive voice.
